title: Anemia or other comorbidities? using machine learning to reveal deeper insights into the drivers of acute coronary syndromes in hospital admitted patients
summary: Interpretable machine-learning models analyzed 4,044 acute-coronary-syndrome admissions across four Gulf countries. Anemia ranked as the strongest predictor for in-hospital heart failure and bleeding, while heart failure ranked highest for mortality; models had AUCs above 0.75. These are observational, cohort-specific associations, not causal effects.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis of acute-coronary-syndrome admissions identifies cohort-specific factors associated with in-hospital outcomes.
